افتكروا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَكَرُوا (iftakarū) /if.ta.ka.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)

# اِفْتَكِرُوا (iftakirū) /if.ta.ki.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِفْتَكَرَ (iftakara)
